about: Hand corrections to registry outfalls' water records, applied by ingest.outfall_water_corrections (scripts/match_outfalls.py and ingest.outfall_waters write them again on every rebuild). Each entry is applied only while the row's receiving-water text is still `stated`. From the registry water audit of 2026-11-28 (research/registry/outfall-water-audit-2026-11-28.md): the permit names a water that has its own record at the outfall's point, and the row was tied to the nearest other record. Distances are from the row's point to the record's outline (build.status Resolver.distance_m).
